$comment: Expected gallery and film counts, in one place. Adding, merging or removing an effect, variant, basic or film changes these on purpose: update the numbers here and say why in the commit. Filters name the gallery buttons; families and basics count visible cards, demos and variants count the matching entries. This revision adds four distinct graphic operations, seven variants of existing effects and five in-card films; the sampler adds no effect family.

films.$cards: Film cards on the home page by section, in page order: the featured cards, then the smaller cards (listed films that are not a version of another film).
